pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided polygonal dark regions with soft, smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries due to high image blur. The spatial area of patches is relatively consistent across the upper neck and lower shoulder regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-pigmented pathways forming a continuous mesh between patches. Junction nodes typically consist of three-way intersections. The thickness of these pathways is narrow and consistent, though edges are poorly defined due to resolution constraints.
